title: Solomon gives Hiram twenty cities in Galilee
description: After Solomon had finished building the Lord's house and the king's palace in twenty years, he gave King Hiram of Tyre twenty cities in Galilee as payment for cedar trees, cypress, and gold. Hiram went himself to see the cities but was not pleased and called the area the land of Cabul. Hiram had sent Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
